name: profile-setup-only
description: Regression spec for /profile: show only profiles created/configured by /setup, hide built-in and auto-detected profiles, and route Create New to the guided setup wizard.

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf %s  | base64 --decode > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -s "$R/plugins" "$H/plugins"; cd "$H"; HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon

steps.description: Create New opened the setup wizard

steps.pattern: Which provider|Paste your API key|sign in with ChatGPT

steps.description: legacy profile form was not opened
